items.title: Curtis Mitchell Interview, 1996-04-02
items.q: The first electric bass I had, I bought it from Walter Payton.

ctx.x: But weren't there some guys that didn't, wouldn't make that transition to electric because it's not cool or it's not, that's not the, the bass, not the true bass sound? Yeah.

Well see what's happening, I don't care too much about playing electric noise now, unless I'm playing rhythm, blues or rock and roll. But when I'm playing jazz, I'm going to play the fiddle. Now if I'm playing rhythm, blues or rock, well I play the, you know. And usually the thing, mostly guitar players make better electric bass players anyway, because they already got that feel, you know, that physical feel, you know. Yeah. The first electric bass I had, I bought it from Walter Payton.
